question: AUTHORITY.md requires that acceptance pass on the version users actually receive before a release is complete. This is that acceptance, run 2026-10-14 against the published release rather than the tag.

action_taken.what: Published a GitHub release for the pre-existing tag v0.3.2 (commit 75cfffb583bc0a241aa3270aa207dcdc21833cf4).
action_taken.authority: AUTHORITY.md 'Release' is a standing delegation and is named as the identified human approval Charter constraint 5 requires for publishing. The version policy in ARCHITECTURE.md permits the agent to cut a patch release; v0.3.1 -> v0.3.2 is a patch. No tag was created, moved or deleted.

acceptance.detail: 6 of 6. Installed into an empty directory; GET /api/version reported serverBuild = clientBuild = b14b70a, matching the build the 2026-10-08 report recorded.
6 of 6, so widening the navigation step did not weaken the suite on the revision that shipped the renamed control.

acceptance.kind: guard check - this run must still fail
acceptance.detail: 4 of 6 failed, as intended: the reconciliation badge below WCAG AA, the field with no fill of its own, the translucent Tetris stats panel, and the crossfade animating under prefers-reduced-motion. The suite was confirmed still able to catch the defects it exists to catch.

suite_defect_found_and_fixed.what: e2e/verify-release.spec.ts navigated by clicking a button named 'Open requests'. That label does not exist before commit bb29a68 (#130); v0.3.2 labels the same control 'Requests' (App.tsx:133).
suite_defect_found_and_fixed.consequence: The suite could only verify the newest revision. Pointed at any older release it timed out on a control the artifact never had, and reported failures that were not defects. This blocked the acceptance AUTHORITY.md requires for any release but the newest.
suite_defect_found_and_fixed.fix: openRequests() resolves either label and throws a named error if neither is present. It widens the navigation step only: the assertions after the click are unchanged.
suite_defect_found_and_fixed.proof_it_did_not_blunt_the_suite: v0.3.1 still fails 4 of 6 with the fix applied, which is the same set of real defects it failed before.

still_open.v0.3.0: Tagged and verified as an installable artifact, never published. Creating a release for it is within the standing delegation but is not obviously useful, because v0.3.1 already superseded it. Recorded rather than decided.
still_open.main_is_ahead: main is 76 commits past v0.3.1 and past the published v0.3.2. It carries the structural UX redesign (#130-#133), the theme ramp (#134), and the two list fixes (#150), none of which any release contains.
still_open.next_version_is_a_maintainer_decision: package.json on main is still 0.3.2. Releasing main would be a minor bump under semver for a delivered artifact, and ARCHITECTURE.md reserves a minor release to the maintainer. Held, not taken.

limits: Acceptance is read-only against the running artifact and exercises six checks; it is not a full regression suite. The 255 unit tests and the stubbed e2e suite run against main, not against the release.

'a rendered reconciliation badge, when the data has one' is conditional on live repository state and passed vacuously here -- the live repository had no conflicting-state issue. The served-stylesheet check covers that badge instead, and this is noted rather than counted as evidence.
The published release is 0.3.2, which is still behind main. Publishing it fixes the accessibility and contrast defects for anyone installing; it does not deliver the redesign.
watermark: agent-recorded under the L1 grant in .yolo/governance/AUTHORITY.md; outcome #153
